rules: H7b (Ahmed, 15 Nov 2026) «التعلّم»: kind learn — a sequence of steps through the REAL learning prompt (prompts.md §7, real model calls) and the REAL guest engine, with the learned cards added to the seed knowledge in memory (the store's own rules — numbering, «امسح», «نعم» / «لا» — are the database's, proved by supabase/tests/guest_hub_learning.sql and the preview-branch e2e).
